title: Type Aliases & Alias Templates (using vs typedef)

slides.title: Modern Type Aliases (using)
slides.prompt: C++11 introduced the using keyword for type aliases. Type aliases offer cleaner syntax than legacy typedef and critically support alias templates.

slides.title: Type Alias Keyword
slides.prompt: Fill in the C++11 keyword used to create a modern type alias.

slides.title: Advantage of using over typedef
slides.prompt: What is the primary technical capability of using aliases that legacy typedef lacks?
options: using statements can be templated (Alias Templates)
using aliases are faster at runtime
using supports dynamic runtime type redefinition
using can alias variable names directly
slides.correctAnswer: using statements can be templated (Alias Templates)

slides.title: Alias Template Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the template header for an alias template wrapping a std::pair.

slides.title: Standard Library _t Suffix Traits
slides.prompt: In <type_traits>, what do aliases ending with _t (e.g. std::decay_t<T>) represent since C++14?
options: Alias templates that simplify typename std::trait_name<T>::type syntax
Type trait checks returning boolean values
slides.correctAnswer: Alias templates that simplify typename std::trait_name<T>::type syntax

slides.title: Function Pointer Alias
slides.prompt: Fill in the type alias for a function pointer taking int and returning void.

slides.title: Typedef Equivalent for Function Pointers
slides.prompt: How does using Func = void(*)(double); compare to typedef void(*Func)(double); readability?
options: using keeps the alias name clearly on the left of = separate from complex syntax
typedef is easier because the name is embedded inside the function pointer syntax
They have identical syntax with no equal sign
using cannot alias function pointer types
slides.correctAnswer: using keeps the alias name clearly on the left of = separate from complex syntax

slides.title: Template Parameterized Map Alias
slides.prompt: Fill in the alias body to create a map with std::string keys and generic values V.

slides.title: Typedef inside Class Templates
slides.prompt: When creating nested type aliases inside a class template prior to C++11, how was a template typedef simulated?
options: By defining a nested struct containing a typedef inside a wrapper template class
It was impossible under any pattern
slides.correctAnswer: By defining a nested struct containing a typedef inside a wrapper template class
